scope: Same 18 pre-existing selected elite JRA turf G1 races 2023-2025, not a representative all-race population. Current-engine diagnostic reference; no new parameter fitting. Prior 2025 holdout has already been viewed.

positionProxyDefinition.notOfficialStyle: Single-race final-corner position proxy, not pre-race habitual style or full-race average position. JRA side-by-side groups share a reported minimum rank. Range is [reported rank, reported rank + group size - 1]; tied groups are not reordered. Point estimate uses reported rank; possible classification and bounds retain uncertainty.
positionProxyDefinition.winRateDenominator: Horse starts classified into this proxy
positionProxyDefinition.confidenceCaveat: Wilson95 treats starts as binomial independent observations; repeated horses and shared-race dependence make it descriptive only. Classification bounds describe label uncertainty only, not sampling confidence.

measurementCaveats: Official final times are reported to 0.1s; equal reported times can still have a nonzero photo-finish margin. Adjacent time differences have this quantization.
Average speed length/finishTime and 600/final600 are nominal course-distance speeds, not actual path speed or instantaneous peak.
Only numeric official margins are converted into lengths. Nose/head/neck/large are retained as raw categories; no fabricated fixed conversion or meter-to-length mapping.
Race first600 and raceSectionals200m are leading-arrival course-marker times; per-horse final600 is individual; not interchangeable.

Cancelled/excluded entries are not starters. DNF horses remain starters. A last-corner position exists only if a cornerNumber=4 record exists. DNF before that point is unclassified; missing times exclude time distributions.
Six distances each have only three races, and distance is coupled to venue/event/grade/age/field. No causal distance-style advantage inferred.
All selected races are turf; dirt, weak grades, wet track, rail changes, wind, exact horse physiology are not calibrated here.

winnerSecondAllRaceMarginOrderStatistics.method: All six nonnumeric photo margins in this sample are nose/head/neck and rank below the smallest numeric margin (1/2 length). Median and p90 use only numeric order statistics; no fixed photo-margin length was assigned. Minimum and mean remain unspecified. Numeric-only subset is separately reported.

researchBenchmarks.title: Speed, pacing strategy and aerodynamic drafting in Thoroughbred horse racing
researchBenchmarks.usage: UK study broad structural pattern. Not a hard speed cap, exact per-distance Japanese target, or universal 500m attack trigger. Drafting-performance association includes ability/position confounding.

researchBenchmarks.title: Speed and incline during thoroughbred horse racing: racehorse speed supports a metabolic power constraint to incline running but not to decline running
researchBenchmarks.usage: Track-specific empirical associations, particularly slower downhill as well as uphill. These are not portable calibration coefficients for every racecourse.

contextOnlyOfficialStyleTable.title: NAR Tokyo Sprint 2022 preview, preceding ten editions
contextOnlyOfficialStyleTable.usage: Official style table but category assignment algorithm is not stated. Course/event/grade/field/horse population differ from the turf-G1 benchmark. Context only; not used as a same-definition engine pass/fail target.
